sources.title: MAI-Thinking-1 | Microsoft AI
sources.snippet: MAI-Thinking-1 (35B active, ~1T total parameters, MoE) has a smaller inference footprint than much larger models, yet is competitive with models in its weight class. Independent human raters on Surge prefer MAI-Thinking-1 for overall quality in blind side-by-sides to Sonnet 4.6 across single and multi-turn tasks.
